population.definition: every entry of config/governance/ast-dispositions.json whose disposition is exclude_with_reason, at the normative commit the acceptance run names
population.size_derivation: counted mechanically from the register; never a quoted number

strata.justification: The two rules have disjoint semantics and disjoint category vocabularies; a simple random draw could leave one rule unexamined, which no property of the population justifies. Proportional stratification is deterministic and adds no free parameter.

size_rule.empty_stratum: skipped with derived-emptiness proof: the register, an independent source, declares no exclusions under that rule (the narrow R10 exception); only an empty total population is blocked
size_rule.note: The sample size is a function of the derived stratum sizes only; no target count and no expected confirmation quota exists.

selection.take: the first ceil(stratum_size/5) candidates of the stratum in ascending key order
selection.note: A pure function of seed and candidate ids: no random state, no clock, no process id, no system entropy, no manual reselection, no exchange of drawn elements.

seed_rule.commit_oid: the full normative commit id the acceptance run names
seed_rule.binding: a manipulated population changes the register blob and therefore the seed and the draw; rule R6 derives both inputs from the commit object

review_protocol.blindness: the dataset handed to the reviewing instance is exactly the validated blind dataset; it contains neither the original exclusion reason nor any category, prior verdict, author information or expected quota
review_protocol.order: all evaluations are stored, their digest is bound in the unblinding comparison record, and only then are they compared with the register; a changed evaluation after unblinding fails via the digest

consequences.reject_exclusion: the affected candidate's category is marked re-examination-required as a whole; every candidate of that category is re-examined, re-confirmed, re-categorised or repaired; afterwards the sample is redrawn against the new normative state
consequences.insufficient_evidence: the cause is established; the blind dataset may be extended only without disclosing original reasons or categories; the review is then performed afresh, never silently upgraded to a confirmation

review_protocol.zero_findings: count as a result only when drawn > 0, evaluated == drawn, every review id evaluated exactly once and the blindness checks passed (the narrow R10 exception)
